response_text: {"decomposition_id":"D4","label":"Cross-Reference of SOX 404(b) to Satisfy FDICIA ICFR with Aligned Cycles","object":"Consolidation of an institution's ICFR assessment and attestation obligations so that a SOX 404(b) attestation is deemed to satisfy the corresponding Part 363 FDICIA ICFR assessment requirement, on a fiscal-year cycle, while preserving safety-and-soundness law compliance as an annex.","consolidated_text":"An institution that obtains an external auditor attestation on internal control over financial reporting under SOX 404(b) shall be deemed to satisfy the corresponding ICFR assessment and attestation requirement of Part 363 (FDICIA), with the two regimes related to one another such that the SOX 404(b) attestation discharges the overlapping FDICIA obligation.
